card.name: All-caps words just before RISK or RENEWABLE
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS headings that come right before the word RISK or RENEWABLE, such as INCREASED, INCREASES THE, LESSER, OTHER or NON. Also fires partway through IMPAIRED in an all-caps heading.

modes.label: Increase before risk
modes.description: Ending of INCREASE(D/S) or the word THE that follows it, in an all-caps boxed warning before RISK.
modes.example: WARNING: ESAs INCREASE<< THE>> RISK OF DEATH, MYOC

modes.label: Before renewable
modes.description: Capitalised or lowercase words such as OTHER or non that lead into the word renewable.
modes.example: University with a Foreword by Arjun Makhijani GROUNDBREAKING STUDY FINDS SOLAR, WIND,<< OTHER>> RENEWABLE POWER SOURCES CO

modes.label: Impaired heading
modes.description: The end of IMPAIRED in an all-caps dosing heading about renal function.
modes.example: impaired, a reduced dosage schedule must be employed. The following dosage guidelines may be used. DOSAGE GUIDELINES FOR PATIENTS WITH IMPAI<<RED>> RENAL FUNCTION Creatinine Clearance mL

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting a word starting with R, such as RISK or RENAL, or RENEWABLE.
card.plain: It spots capitalised warning phrases where the next word is likely to be RISK or RENAL.
